open_points.subject: PERSONAL_DATA_FIELDS
open_points.question: What are the complete rows and exact field paths of `PERSONAL_DATA_FIELDS`, including nested objects, list items, import mappings and every other answer shape?
options: Enumerate every answer-model field path explicitly
Classify answer fields recursively from the State 1 model-field classes
open_points.default_guess: Generate explicit answer-field paths recursively from the State 1 classifications and review the resulting table.

open_points.subject: answer disclosure classification
open_points.text: when one of those fields holds a value
open_points.question: Precisely when does a classified field hold a value: how are null, an explicit absent marker, an empty object, an empty list and a list containing only records without personal fields classified?
options: Only an actual personal-data leaf value counts
Any present field, including an empty collection or absent marker, counts
A nonempty container counts even when none of its elements carries a personal-data value
open_points.default_guess: Count only an actual personal-data leaf value; absence and empty containers do not raise the answer's class.

witness.initial: A project-list answer contains an empty `projects` collection.
events: Cabinet requests the project list and `operations` computes the answer's class.
outcomes: The empty collection contains no personal-data fact, so the answer is `business_confidential`.
The classified collection field is present and holds an empty-list value, so the answer is `personal_data`.
witness.observer: The contract and semantic-test verifier sees the different declared class.

open_points.subject: file-part stream failure
open_points.text: A stream that ends before the closing delimiter is a failure
open_points.question: What exact result or exception does the stream owned by `upload_framing` expose so that `migration_import` can distinguish premature termination from normal end-of-part, and which contract owns that protocol?
options: Reading returns a tagged terminal failure
The stream exposes an out-of-band completion status checked after reading
open_points.default_guess: Define an `upload_framing` stream exception that `migration_import` catches and maps to `file_unreadable`.

open_points.subject: owner session cookie transport
open_points.text: The session cookie is always HTTPS-only
open_points.question: Does Registry guarantee that the cookie is never transmitted over plain HTTP, or does it merely set the cookie's HTTPS-only attribute while allowing browser-specific loopback transmission over plain HTTP?
options: The cookie must never travel over plain HTTP, including loopback
Registry always sets the HTTPS-only attribute, but a browser may still send it to a plain-HTTP loopback origin
Plain-HTTP loopback is unsupported unless the host supplies HTTPS
open_points.default_guess: Always set the HTTPS-only attribute and require host-provided HTTPS whenever the browser will not send it on loopback.

witness.initial: The owner signs in through Registry's loopback interface served over plain HTTP.
events: The browser makes the next owner-interface request to the same plain-HTTP loopback origin.
outcomes: Because the cookie is always HTTPS-only, it is not sent and the request is refused as unauthenticated.
As the later passage permits, the browser sends it over plain HTTP and the authenticated request is served.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a usable session or an immediate request to sign in again.
